title: hypolepis alpina

It is native to the mountainous regions of South America and the Andes mountains. Hypolepis alpina has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hypolepis alpina include analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins.
